faqs.q: What types of liquor licences are available?
faqs.a: Licence types include Small bar licence, Club and hotel liquor licences, On-premises liquor licence, Packaged liquor licence, Producer/wholesaler liquor licence, Liquor approved manager licence, and Limited liquor licence.

faqs.q: How do I pay the annual liquor licence fee?
faqs.a: You can pay an annual liquor licence fee using the dedicated transaction page.

faqs.q: What if I need to transfer my liquor licence?
faqs.a: You can apply to transfer a liquor licence whether or not the previous licensee consents, or if the transfer is due to death, disability, or bankruptcy.

faqs.q: What if I need to change my licence details?
faqs.a: You can change details on a liquor licence, change the name of the licence, or change the boundaries of the licensed premises.
